headline: H100 SXM index falls -19% and H200 -14% over 7 days while other GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index sits at $4.32 after a -19% weekly move, with Vast.ai cheapest at $2.40 versus a $10.68 hyperscaler median.
H200 dropped -14% to a $5.40 index, and its $3.97 marketplace median undercuts the $5.29 neocloud median.
B200, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were unchanged at +0%, with B200 indexed at $8.50 and a $14.12 hyperscaler median.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, with RunPod Secure Cloud at $2.39, though only 4 providers list it.
Hyperscaler premiums remain wide, led by H100 SXM at +162% and MI300X at +131%.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM and H200 declines carry into B200 pricing, which held at +0% this week.
